# Monitoring the planet

[Earth observation] provides repeated measurements of the surface.

Instruments reading [signal-to-noise ratio|SNR] data can work in low light, and [SNR] also resolves as an alias.

Use [remote-sensing], [Remote Sensing] or [link budget].

An ordinary link to [ESA](https://www.esa.int/) is untouched, and so is `[albedo]` in code.

```md
[albedo] in a fenced block stays literal.
```
